Our security team needs a clear evidence plan up front (SOC 2 report, SIG/CAIQ answers, DPA redline + retention window).

- Can Redwood commit to a 3-week evidence sprint to get to a signable SOW?
- Can you provide a short MAP (milestones + owners) and a checklist of the exact artifacts you need from us?
- We need DPA retention options called out clearly (30/90/365 days + archival).

I attached LedgerCorp's SIG template with the questions we've prioritized. If we can get an initial MAP and a quick sync tomorrow, security will try to pull the SOC 2 (cert + bridge letter) and CAIQ answers.

Thanks Lina — appreciate the clear priority list. Attaching a compressed MAP draft (attached) that maps milestones to owners and an evidence checklist for the items you listed. Summary below — happy to iterate in the call.

Proposed 3-week sprint (compressed):
1) Week 0 (today–Fri): Align MAP, confirm owners, sign intake SOW pre-approval (DocuSign).
2) Week 1: Evidence intake — LedgerCorp provides SOC 2 cert/bridge + CAIQ, Redwood shares SIG answers draft and opens evidence bucket for upload.
3) Week 2: Technical validation & Q&A — Redwood validates artifacts, traces data residency/retention controls; legal teams reconcile any DPA carveouts.
4) Week 3: Finalize SOW, sign, and kickoff POC.

Specific asks (what we need from LedgerCorp by EOD Nov 18 to hit target):
- SOC 2 Type II report PDF + any current bridge letter
- Completed CAIQ export (or answers to prioritized SIG rows)
- Primary DPA redline areas: retention window preference, subprocessors list, and audit access cadence

I propose a 1-hr working session tomorrow (Wed 18 Nov) 10:00–11:00 PT to align the MAP and owners. Ben (solutions) will own the evidence intake flow and Irene (legal) will help triage DPA redlines.

Lina / Naomi — quick technical notes to make the evidence sprint predictable: we recommend the following evidence routing and temp access pattern.

- Evidence bucket: we will provide a temporary S3 bucket with a scoped IAM role. Files should follow this layout: /soc2/, /caiaq/, /config-dumps/.
- Required SOC 2 items: full report PDF, bridge letter, and auditor contact (if available).
- SIG/CAIQ: the prioritized rows you sent are sufficient; if you can export as CSV that speeds ingestion.
- DPA/retention: from infra side we can support retention flags at these tiers: 30d (default), 90d (staging), 365d (archival). We can also enable longer archival via customer-managed S3 if LedgerCorp requires custody.

Operationally: assign an "evidence sprint owner" on LedgerCorp side (name + email) who will upload artifacts and respond to clarifying questions. We'll set up a separate Slack channel for rapid triage during Week 1.
